# A2.08 UX spec writing

## Owner
A2

## Stage
Understand

## Phase
1

## Checkpoint
CP-01

## Input (reads)
Screen inventory, states, stories

## Steps
1. Write one section per screen: purpose, controls, flow to next screen.
2. Leave design choices the source does not make as TBD.
3. Cite the source for each line

## Output (writes)
Screen-level UX spec

## Save path
`docs/sdlc/stories/<ID>/ux-spec.md`

## Verification
No line without a source ID or TBD

## Checkpoints raised
- none
